subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Transaction Monitoring Systems
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Transaction Monitoring Systems.

hook.text: A bank processes millions of transactions daily. Hidden in the flow are a handful of suspicious ones.

buildup.text: Transaction monitoring systems use rules and algorithms to flag unusual patterns for human review.

discovery.text: Common red flags include rapid movement of funds, round-number transfers, and structuring patterns.

twist.text: Systems generate thousands of false positives daily. Analysts waste time on innocent transactions.

climax.text: AI-powered monitoring reduces false positives, but the technology is still catching up to criminal creativity.

punchline.text: Millions of transactions. Thousands of alerts. Most are false.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge with transaction monitoring?
options: High volumes of false positive alerts
Monitoring is not required by law
